title: symbolicSystem: ODE2ResidualLHS and ODE2ResidualLHSJacobian, the side of the residual in the name
author: Claude-JG
description: Maintainer 2026-10-29: ODE2Residual and ODE2ResidualJacobian (#3155) shall say whether they are RHS or LHS, otherwise the sign is unclear. The residual is M q_tt - f, all terms on the left-hand side: ODE2Residual -> ODE2ResidualLHS, ODE2ResidualJacobian -> ODE2ResidualLHSJacobian; SystemResidual keeps the name of the Exudyn solver function.
releaseNotes: exudyn.misc.symbolicSystem: ODE2ResidualLHS and ODE2ResidualLHSJacobian (were ODE2Residual, ODE2ResidualJacobian): the residual M q_tt - f with all terms on the left-hand side, the side in the name for the sign
